pages.text: Addendum for $(l:structures/family_tree)$(c)$(o)Family Trees$().$(br)$(br)I am still unsure how I truly feel about this plague. On one side, its grotesque look speaks for itself - it's an absolute abomination on existence, something unquestionably unnatural. It basically destroys the current version of whatever it touches and makes it part of the plague. On the other hand... I still can't forget my father's

face as he held my sister's corpse. He shouted out into the sky for something to save my sister and the plague was the only thing that responded. It appeared in the form of black sprouts growing from my father's body and they enveloped my sister's corpse. For a second, my father was frightened, but then he began to cry happily as he heard my sister's voice - something I did not hear. It seems their bodies became connected through the plant-like tendrils piercing them; which continued

to grow for hours. Yet, my father - even as he had already half-turned into a tree - was genuinely happy... I know my father; that was not the plague controlling him or inducing some sort of madness. No. That was him and his actual smile brought forth from happiness. The plague answered his desperation and gave him exactly what he asked for in the way it could. He even asked me to join him, but I refused. I could barely look at that monstrous scene, so there was no way I could be a part

of it. My father seemed to know as well how messed up it was, but he didn't want to leave my sister to die. Through those familial, bonds a fully sized Family Tree grew in just a single day. I can see Crystallized Bonds still popping out from the tree even now whenever I visit it, so I do believe that they are still happy and together - in the same way that I believe that the one my father heard was truly my sister. From what I know so far, the plague is definitely capable of that much

at least... Nonetheless, I'm still conflicted with the Joyplague. I hope that through this research I am doing, I can reach some form of acceptance or... anything, I don't know.$(br)$(br)$(br)I feel tired.
